text:
The `404: Resource not found` error occurs because Azure OpenAI endpoints require an `api-version` query parameter to route requests properly.

### Solution

Update your endpoint format in your configuration (`config.yaml` or `.env`) to include the `api-version` query parameter:

```text
https://<resource>.openai.azure.com/openai?api-version=2025-04-01-preview
```

For your specific resource (`create2024seopenai`), configure the endpoint as:

```text
https://create2024seopenai.openai.azure.com/openai?api-version=2025-04-01-preview
```

Hermes automatically preserves query parameters such as `api-version` when making Azure OpenAI requests.
